newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT-LatInvest starts Edegel buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-LatInvest starts Edegel buy.

text.p: LatInvest said on Friday it had started coverage of Peruvian power generator Edegel SA with a rating of long-term buy.
The brokerage said that with the shares carrying an attractive yield of eight percent for 1997 there was a good opportunity to buy into weakness.

Edegel has fallen 30 percent since June on concerns that it has had to buy in the spot market to make up for shortfalls due to dry conditions and is trading at a 47 percent discount to its peer group.
But LatInvest said the long-term outlook was promising due to a shift in sales from the regulated to the higher margin unregulated market.
